title: Copper Tundra: The Herbalist's Aurora Register
premise: In a magnetized polar steppe threaded by buried power rails, the herbalist must isolate the cure from hazardous blooms using a woven specimen satchel.
ending: Recover the Aurora Register and return with the restorative field formula; Polar Surveyors can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive conductive frost while evading the rail colossus without sacrificing the restorative field formula.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Polar Surveyors to witness the woven specimen satchel.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to harvest a rare living specimen
